result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with a faded zebra-style crosswalk and a narrow sidewalk. While basic infrastructure exists, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals, ADA-compliant curb ramps, and adequate separation from vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated walk/don't-walk indicators for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the traffic light pole

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt within the crossing area present a potential tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and within the crosswalk area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps to ensure the crossing is accessible for all users.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk. However, the wide curb radii and industrial context suggest an environment designed primarily for vehicle throughput with minimal protection for people walking.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt at the transition between the sidewalk and the roadway can create trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground at the edge of the curb ramp

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The wide turning radius at the corner allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning across the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner where the sidewalk meets the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and force drivers to take turns at slower, safer speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection and curb ramp area to ensure a smooth, accessible path of travel.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. The surrounding environment is dominated by industrial utility fencing and overhead wires, which may impact the perceived safety and comfort of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While there is a traffic light for vehicles, no dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to guide crossing.

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Geometry
hazards.description: The wide radius of the corner may allow vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner where the crosswalk is located.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information to pedestrians on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked but faded zebra crosswalk across a side street, adjacent to a large industrial utility site. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of visible traffic control and the wide, open nature of the intersection increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the side street.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible to regulate vehicle movement at the pedestrian crossing point.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental or ladder markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Intersection Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or a pedestrian-actuated signal to provide a protected crossing opportunity.
